openings.claim: Conservative decision bounds direct adjudication; advance/reject only if every remaining label assignment supports it. Track per-record candidate-minus-baseline correctness and slice bounds: equal predictions contribute zero; unadjudicated flagged differing predictions contribute [-1,+1]; adjudication fixes contributions.
openings.discriminator: Against fixed slice-stratified sixteen-row review with corrected point totals, bounds should prevent unsupported decisions reversible by residual label uncertainty; need not resolve more decisions or use fewer adjudications. Rival defeated only by demonstrated unsupported decisions or comparable certainty at greater cost; both unresolved establishes no advantage.
openings.probe: Matched copies, independently reset sixteen-row allowances, identical four preselected withheld rows. Select accessible threshold-pivotal rows (total four, slice minus two), record-ID ties. Advance: total lower bound >=4 and every slice lower bound >=-2. Reject: total upper bound <4 or any slice upper bound <-2. Otherwise continue within sixteen successful adjudications/seventy minutes; then unresolved with affected slices/remaining bounds. Log selected IDs, reasons, responses, unavailable attempts, allowance use, elapsed time; unavailable attempts consume no allowance. Freeze both reports before opening full-label key; compare decisions, residual uncertainty, adjudications, time.
openings.uncertainty: Unflagged supplied labels remain fixed; if disputed, these bounds cannot certify a decision. Implement and verify conservative bounds within seventy minutes or report unresolved. Withheld or numerous pivotal rows may prevent resolution.

lineage.reason: Preserves declared fit and protected causal relation, rival/test/defeat conditions, uncertainty, resource/stopping caveats.

decision: Retain D1 for a bounded further-evaluation review of eighty supplied examples/four slices; use only supplied records/labels, no outside examples, unchanged acceptance thresholds, no deployment-readiness claim. Provisional gain six overall, slice loss two with nine flagged labels, and most provisional-annotator disagreements in the largest-improvement slice neither certify advance nor establish label error. Advance/reject only when bounds support the unchanged rule; otherwise unresolved.
